purpose: Edit a single committed text value through an explicit local draft, validation, save and cancel lifecycle.
behaviorProvider: React local draft and operation guards; shared TextInput, Field and Button behaviors.

requirements.statement: Enter editing with a snapshot of the current value, focus and select the native TextInput, and keep subsequent typing in a local draft.
Enter outside IME composition and the Save action validate then save; blur does not commit. Escape or Cancel discards the draft except while a save is pending.
Reject required whitespace-only drafts and truthy synchronous validation messages before onSave. A thrown validator becomes the configured generic error rather than exposing exception text.
Exit an unchanged valid draft without calling onSave. Cancel and successful completion restore focus to the edit button when that button remains mounted and focusable.
Permit at most one in-flight save. Pending disables the input and Cancel, makes the root busy, and displays saving status; the shared Save button is loading.
Retain the failed draft and present the configured error when onSave rejects. Ignore completion state updates from an operation invalidated by unmount.
If the controlled value differs from the entry snapshot before save, block the callback and show conflictMessage; Cancel returns to the latest host value.
Disabled blocks entering or saving and disables an open input. Read-only omits Edit in display state and prevents editing/saving an already-open draft; neither prop silently commits it.

Update value after accepted persistence and use previousValue for server-side concurrency protection. The local pre-save comparison is not a transaction and cannot detect a remote change occurring during the request.
Own form submission and errors beyond this one field. InlineEdit provides no named native submission field and its actions do not submit an enclosing form.
Use input group tokens for the wrapper; nested Field, TextInput and Button retain their own category styling.

limitations: Synchronous validation only; onSave may be asynchronous. No debounce, autosave or blur-save policy.
A pending operation cannot be cancelled through this control; aborting network work and server concurrency belong to the host.
Required validation uses a default English message; product localization and richer field validation need the host callback.
